category_title: Silent English Language Learners with extensive digital literacy practices
scenario_title: Group work and oral summary in traditional classroom
minimal_context: Wei is sitting with his peers during group work in the traditional English classroom, where he has been assigned to deliver a 5-minute oral summary.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Wei, your group members said you are going to do the 5-minute summary for the presentation tomorrow. Let's hear what you have so far.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Exhibits an absolute lack of communication in the traditional English classroom environment. He literally will not talk.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You only have one day to prepare. What are you going to say?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Never speaks, appearing to feel so uncomfortable and showing anxiety about failing.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to participate in the group work. Just tell me one sentence.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Maintains an absolute lack of communication, appearing so afraid of the group work and showing feelings of vulnerability.)
